FieldStats.description:
Per-field statistics written by verification over every page of the cluster; kept in the
spec for drift detection on later crawls. Extra keys are allowed.

presence_rate.description: Share of pages where the field has a value.
presence_rate.title: Presence Rate

expected_presence.description: Presence rate the analysis expected from the field's path (`p`).
expected_presence.title: Expected Presence

multiplicity.description: For scalars: share of pages with a match where the selector matched exactly one node.
multiplicity.title: Multiplicity

type_check_pass.description: Share of extracted values that pass the field's `type_check`.
type_check_pass.title: Type Check Pass

rows_min.description: record_list: fewest rows on a page where present.
rows_min.title: Rows Min

rows_max.description: record_list: most rows on a page where present.
rows_max.title: Rows Max

keys_seen.description: key_value: distinct keys seen across the cluster.
keys_seen.title: Keys Seen

pages_scored.description: Pages the statistics were computed on.
pages_scored.title: Pages Scored

FieldStats.title: FieldStats

GeneratedBy.description: Provenance: which model and prompt wrote the spec, from which pages. Extra keys allowed.

model.description: Model id that wrote the spec.
model.title: Model

prompt_version.description: Prompt id used for generation, e.g. `specgen.v1`.
prompt_version.title: Prompt Version

pages_seen.description: URLs of the pages merged into the union page.
pages_seen.title: Pages Seen

mode.description: `prompted` (user fields.yaml), `unprompted` (LLM named the fields) or `fallback` (path-induced selectors, no LLM).
mode.title: Mode

repair_calls.description: Repair LLM calls spent on this spec.
repair_calls.title: Repair Calls

repair_prompt_version.description: Prompt id used for repair, e.g. `repair.v1`.
repair_prompt_version.title: Repair Prompt Version

GeneratedBy.title: GeneratedBy

KeyValueField.description:
An object: `pairs` matches one element per pair, `key` and `value` are relative to it.
Keys lose a trailing colon; the first occurrence of a key wins.

description.description: What the field holds, in words (from fields.yaml or the LLM).
description.title: Description

optional.description: True when the analysis found the field's path on fewer than 95% of the cluster's pages, so a null is not a failure.
optional.title: Optional

degraded.description: Set by verification when the field still fails on some pages after the repair budget is spent; see `stats` for its rates.
degraded.title: Degraded

selection_reason.description: Why verification picked the selected candidate.
selection_reason.title: Selection Reason

source_candidates.description: Analysis candidate ids (e.g. c17) this field maps to.
source_candidates.title: Source Candidates

pairs.description: Absolute XPath matching one element per key/value pair.
pairs.title: Pairs

pairs_alternates.description: Up to two alternative pair selectors (the 2-3 candidates rule); extraction uses `pairs` only.
pairs_alternates.title: Pairs Alternates

key.description: XPath relative to the pair element for the key.
key.title: Key

value.description: XPath relative to the pair element for the value.
value.title: Value

KeyValueField.title: KeyValueField

ListField.description: An array of values: every node the selector matches (0..N), in document order.

description.description: What the field holds, in words (from fields.yaml or the LLM).
description.title: Description

optional.description: True when the analysis found the field's path on fewer than 95% of the cluster's pages, so a null is not a failure.
optional.title: Optional

degraded.description: Set by verification when the field still fails on some pages after the repair budget is spent; see `stats` for its rates.
degraded.title: Degraded

selection_reason.description: Why verification picked the selected candidate.
selection_reason.title: Selection Reason

source_candidates.description: Analysis candidate ids (e.g. c17) this field maps to.
source_candidates.title: Source Candidates

candidates.description: Two or three distinct absolute XPath 1.0 selectors for the same value.
candidates.title: Candidates

selected.description: Index of the candidate extraction uses (set by verification).
selected.title: Selected

fallbacks.description: Candidate indices tried in order when the selected one matches nothing; verification only lists candidates that agree with the winner.
fallbacks.title: Fallbacks

transforms.description: Transforms applied in order to each matched item (closed set: strip, normalize_ws, regex(pattern, group), split(sep, index), replace(old, new), cast(int|float|date), attr(name)).
transforms.title: Transforms

type_check.description: Expected value type, checked by verification.
type_check.title: Type Check

ListField.title: ListField

RecordListField.description:
An array of objects: `container` matches each row, each column XPath is relative to the
row. Rows whose columns are all null are dropped.

description.description: What the field holds, in words (from fields.yaml or the LLM).
description.title: Description

optional.description: True when the analysis found the field's path on fewer than 95% of the cluster's pages, so a null is not a failure.
optional.title: Optional

degraded.description: Set by verification when the field still fails on some pages after the repair budget is spent; see `stats` for its rates.
degraded.title: Degraded

selection_reason.description: Why verification picked the selected candidate.
selection_reason.title: Selection Reason

source_candidates.description: Analysis candidate ids (e.g. c17) this field maps to.
source_candidates.title: Source Candidates

container.description: Absolute XPath matching every row element.
container.title: Container

container_alternates.description: Up to two alternative container selectors (the 2-3 candidates rule); verification may promote one, extraction uses `container` only.
container_alternates.title: Container Alternates

columns.description: Column name -> XPath relative to the row (starts with `.`). With `column_source: header_row` cells are addressed by header text, never by position.
columns.title: Columns

column_source.description: `header_row` when column names came from `<th>` text, `llm` when the LLM named them (headerless tables may then address cells by position).
column_source.title: Column Source

transforms.description: Column name -> transform chain for that column.
transforms.title: Transforms

RecordListField.title: RecordListField

extraction keeps the first non-null match.
